question_text: A linked-list object waiting has append(node), which adds a node at its tail. Describe waiting.append(ClientNode("Ari Moon", "070123")), where ClientNode constructs a new node from name and phone.

solution: A new ClientNode is instantiated with the supplied name and phone, and that node is added to the end of waiting.
